name: compose_doctor
description: Lint docker-compose / Compose Spec files for production-hygiene issues — unpinned images, missing healthchecks, missing restart policy, missing resource caps, write-all bind mounts.
author: JARVIS

tools.name: compose_lint
tools.description: Lint a docker-compose file (or directory of them) for production-hygiene issues. Returns a findings list grouped by severity.

path.description: Path to a compose YAML file OR a directory to scan for docker-compose*.yml / compose*.yml. Defaults to current dir.
